acceptance: chDB loads on macOS 27 in a documented way, or the unsupported combination is documented and enforced with a clear message.
Whether the 3.6.0 hang and timestamp error occur on 4.x is recorded.
context: Source: PR #2677 close-out. Related: dlv2-10-chdb-cwd-guard (done), tuning-liveness-e2e-gates-20261001 (needs a working chDB for the ClickHouse cell).
description:
## Problem
On this macOS (Darwin 27, arm64) the pinned chDB 4.1.6 native library cannot be loaded ("chdb-core engine not found"), so the chDB-dependent ClickHouse local tests are skipped (tests/unit/platforms/test_clickhouse_adapter.py: embedded mode, real DDL, and others) and real-CLI ClickHouse runs cannot use the pinned engine. The W2 end-to-end runs used chDB 3.6.0 from a scratch `PYTHONPATH` target instead. With that older engine two oddities appeared: a non-fatal metadata timestamp error, and an occasional silent hang at "Saving tuning metadata…". Neither is confirmed to occur on 4.x.

## Change
- Find out why chDB 4.1.6 (chdb-core) fails to load on macOS 27 (wheel tags, dylib deps, code signing) and either fix the install path, document the constraint, or pin a version that loads.
- Check whether the metadata timestamp error and the "Saving tuning metadata…" hang reproduce on a loading 4.x engine; file or fix them.
- Make the skip reason actionable so a skipped chDB test is visible in the lane summary.

## Guardrails
- Do not remove tests to avoid the skip.
